assessment_metadata.title: Authoritative ARX Radar Universe Readiness Assessment (Issue #166)
assessment_metadata.production_authority_rationale: The relationship between the inspected local developer database (.finance_market_store.db, 61 symbols, 7,951 daily bars) and the earlier reported store containing 585 symbols and 228,937 bars cannot be established from available local artifacts. No live production database queries were executed during this audit turn in strict observance of operational boundaries and SEC trial isolation. Therefore, production authority is marked NOT_CHECKED.

cohort_500_candidate.promotion_distinction: Contains the 250 promoted symbols as a subset, but the 500 cohort as a whole has NEVER received production promotion.

blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.finding: In the inspected local database, 445 candidate symbols have 0 bars (MISSING_MARKET_DATA) and 55 have 50-199 bars (INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY for 200 SMA). Zero symbols have >= 200 bars.
blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.scope_limitation: Finding applies strictly to inspected local store (/Users/iDavid/.finance_market_store.db). Production market store authority is NOT_CHECKED.
blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.historical_claim_status: The historical '439/500 stale' claim from prior status reports remains an unverified historical measurement whose calculation basis is not established by local artifacts.

blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.finding: In the inspected local database, asset_ohlcv_provenance has 0 rows across all symbols, and the universe store has 0 rows.
blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.scope_limitation: Finding applies strictly to inspected local store. Production provenance authority is NOT_CHECKED.
blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.historical_claim_status: The historical '67 symbols lacked provenance' claim remains an unverified historical figure whose specific symbol roster cannot be confirmed from local artifacts.

blocker_3_snapshot_compatibility_and_cod.finding: Under the publication integrity contract (ScannerPublicationIntegrityEngine), snapshot compatibility is governed by the 6-component ScannerVersionTuple, component content hashes, and semantic fingerprint, rather than git commit SHAs alone. While scanner_runner.py line 1009 contains an implementation release SHA check against CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_RELEASE_SHA, commit SHAs can differ across non-functional documentation PRs without establishing semantic incompatibility. However, the inspected local scanner store contains 0 VCP snapshots. Therefore, local snapshot compatibility cannot be established.
blocker_3_snapshot_compatibility_and_cod.scope_limitation: Production snapshot serving state is NOT_CHECKED.
